title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Convert XML processing to use libxml2
description:
Convert the "home grown" XML parsing to use the libxml2 API.

Ping #20508

notes.body: I found a few captures to verify functionality, but figured a second set of eyes would still be good.
Sorry, I don't have traces any more. Currently traveling as well.

Here is a minimal example which doesn't work any longer, seem end-of-options is dropped?

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<traceCollecFile
    xmlns="http://www.3gpp.org/ftp/specs/archive/32_series/32.423#traceData"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.3gpp.org/ftp/specs/archive/32_series/32.423#traceData">
  <fileHeader fileFormatVersion="32.423 V15.0.0">
    <traceCollec beginTime="2022-11-15T15:35:00,616+01:00"/>
  </fileHeader>
  <traceRecSession>
    <msg function="N1">
      <rawMsg protocol="NAS">7E004E5002020026020000</rawMsg>
    </msg>
  </traceRecSession>
</traceCollecFile>
```

This example has problem with "protocol" which cut protocol name short "nas" instead of "nas-eps_plain"

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<traceCollecFile
    xmlns="http://www.3gpp.org/ftp/specs/archive/32_series/32.423#traceData"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.3gpp.org/ftp/specs/archive/32_series/32.423#traceData">
  <fileHeader fileFormatVersion="32.423 V10.5.0">
    <traceCollec beginTime="2013-09-11T15:45:00,666+02:00"/>
  </fileHeader>
  <traceRecSession>
    <msg function="S1" name="Deactivate EPS bearer context accept">
      <rawMsg protocol="NAS" version="001">6202CE</rawMsg>
    </msg>
  </traceRecSession>
</traceCollecFile>
```
Nice catch!  Exposed an "order of operations" problem that I didn't see on the captures I've tested.  Fix posted.

Same here, end of options is missing and something unknown in insert. Notice that "Port" doesn't work, not even before this change. If you want to correct that? Source and Dest port
